documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V3.0: PETG-CF
Bambu PETG CF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701G50 (Jul. 01. 2026)
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PETG-CF
Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters

notes: Independent second extraction (agent-2). No other curated file for this product was read.

Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (Mechanical Properties, p.2; specimens printed at 255 °C nozzle / 70 °C bed / 150 mm/s / 100% infill and annealed and dried at 65 °C for 8 h before testing, p.3). The registry has one key per scope and no *.printed / *.material split, so the Z values are named in each row's note and not stored. Density, melting and glass transition (DSC) are material properties under material.* / thermal.*; Vicat and HDT come from the same Physical Properties table.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2460 ± 230 MPa, Z 1340 ± 150 MPa), melt index (19.3 ± 2.4 g/10 min at 250 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature ("N/A"), HDT 68 °C at 1.8 MPa (the 0.45 MPa value is stored), saturated water absorption rate (0.30% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed, with desiccant), retraction length (0.8 - 1.4 mm) and speed (30 - 60 mm/s), max overhang angle (~ 70°), max bridging length (~ 30 mm), support ("Turn on"), build plate surface preparation ("Glue"), spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), the X1 Series heatbed drying alternative (75 - 85 °C, 12 h), annealing advice (55 to 60 °C for 65 to 70 hours), and the odor, composition, skin hazard, chemical stability, solubility, acid / alkali / solvent / oil resistance, flammability and combustion-product rows.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: CLP "Not classified", no hazard pictogram or signal word, composition (PETG 90-95 %, carbon fiber 5-10 % by wt), physical state "Thread", the carbon-fibre handling warning (gloves when loading/unloading, cutting or sanding), conditions to avoid (fire, elevated temperatures, direct sunlight), and "Not hazardous goods" for transport. Its model code "G50-xx" is not written as identity.model (the identity map supplies identity.model "PETG-CF"). Its section 9 "No data available" does not override the TDS values.

Official sources disagree (TDS stored, others named in the row notes): bed temperature (TDS 65 - 75 °C vs wiki 60 - 80 ℃), oven drying (TDS 65 °C 8 h vs material table 70 ℃ 8 h vs drying and PETG wikis 60-65 °C 8 h), AMS 2 Pro / AMS HT drying time (12 h in the material table and drying wiki vs 8 h in the PETG wiki), heatbed drying (TDS and drying wiki 75 - 85 °C 12 h vs PETG wiki 80 °C 12 h), AMS lite (PETG wiki and store page "not compatible" vs material table "Not Recommended").

Nozzle size advice differs between official sources (no key holds a recommended size): the store FAQ recommends a 0.6 mm hardened steel nozzle ("While a 0.4 mm hardened steel nozzle can be used, a 0.6 mm hardened steel nozzle is recommended"), while the wiki material table marks 0.4 mm "Bambu PETG-CF: Recommended" and says a 0.4 mm hardened steel nozzle is "highly recommended as the first choice" for Bambu PETG-CF. Both list 0.4, 0.6 and 0.8 mm as usable, as the TDS does.

Consistency with the parsed store page: material.diameter 1.75 mm and material.net_weight 1000 g (option "1 kg") agree; the page relations (AMS 2 Pro, AMS HT, AMS compatible; AMS lite not compatible) agree. The page states the ± 0.03 mm diameter tolerance, which no document states, so material.diameter_tolerance is neither curated nor not_published. No curated value conflicts with a page value.

Not curated: safety.certifications. The store page links a RoHS document (https://store.bblcdn.com/87dee4bc82c64829b94c0a8d6e55e23c.pdf) that is not in the cached set; it is neither read nor marked not_published.
No in-the-box list: filament has no official in-the-box list.
